profile.headline: Frontend Developer at Leads-IQ
profile.summary: My name is Michelle Lee. I am a floral designer, who went back to earn her BA in Graphic Design. I expanded my knowledge into design thinking and fell love with the language of HTML, CSS and JavaScript coding. My journey has a been full of twist and turns, highs and lows, but I appreciate all the experiences it has given me, and I am excited for what's to come. I will be a great addition to your team because my unique experiences in floral design, special events and product development have given me a different perspective to my approach in design thinking. I am no stranger to thinking outside the box when it comes to problems and setbacks or having to come up with solutions in high stress situations. The key is to keep calm and think positive, and then you will be able to quickly see solutions. I am a UX designer because I love to create and build designs that give positive experiences and improve the quality of life for its users.

positions.title: Freelance Web/Visual Designer
positions.description: Developed graphic illustrations and typography for marketing campaigns and website design. Customization in responsive web interfaces for desktop, tablet and mobile devices and experienced in designing web interfaces in content management in CMS programs like Squarespace, Wordpress and other CMS platforms.  I have experience in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript coding. I have worked on creating graphics and logos for brand identity and merchandise.

positions.title: Web & Interactive Marketing
positions.description: Awakenings is a non-profit organization for survivors of sexual violence. Due to the covid pandemic, I collaborated alongside their team to create a virtual exhibition for their 2021 mixed media exhibition: RETURN featured on the Awakenings website. RETURN showcases four artists from previous exhibits to tell their story of courage and healing. EMBODYING JUSTICE demonstrates the artwork of survivors of the human sex slaves, known as “comfort women,” by the Japanese government/army during the WWII. I built responsive web interfaces for desktop, tablet and mobile devices to showcase these two exhibits online. I developed style sheets, wireframes, and a high-fidelity mockup of the virtual exhibition. The virtual showcase features a mix of audio, video, and image media to showcase each artist’s collection. RETURN opened on February 5, 2021, and you may view it on awakeningsart.org.  I continued my affiliation with Awakenings but now I serve as a volunteer. As of June 2021, I am building their virtual exhibit web page for Embodying Justice, which opens June 19, 2021 and will run until December 2021.

positions.title: Freelance Designer - Special Events
positions.description: I design, build, and stage weddings, dohls (a Korean first birthday celebration), and other special events. I have done it all: consulted with clients to discuss themes, designs, and concepts; worked with vendors, staff, and venues to coordinate materials, timetables, and schedules; and execute all details from the beginning (delegation and production), middle (transport and installation) the very end (disassembly and clean-up). My greatest takeaway is it has taught me how to communicate well with others. I am transparent with what is possible and what is not for their special day. However, I will design and build to the best of my abilities to ensure my clients experience their best day. As I ideate and iterate ideas and designs, I empathize with their needs and concerns first. My mantra is, “It is the client’s day, not yours.” I will say the phrase to myself and others when either of us impedes their demands and wishes onto my clients. It was one of my first lessons learned on my first wedding job, and I have kept to it since then.

positions.title: Designer
positions.description: I combined my creativity skills in design with my analytical skills. I incorporated user feedbacking/testing and UX research to aide in new product development or redesign. In my research, I would study new trends and styles in the market and examine our competitors' collections and product styles. I analyzed sales, losses, and the net promoter (NPS) statistics scores, which showed customer feedback.  I compiled all the data together into PowerPoint presentations. Then we utilized the competitive analysis and customer feedback to iterate and ideate product development. I work with professional photographers and an in-house creative team to produce content used in marketing campaigns, catalogs, social media, and other digital media.

positions.title: Data Entry
positions.description: I worked at Canteen Vending in data Entry and database maintenance. I am familiar with the operation software: i-Vend. Warehouse Inventory maintenance: Warehouse inventory movement control, purchase orders/invoice, merchandise and expense reports, ect

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Mastercraft Vending and Coffee was a company with twenty-five to thirty employees. My responsibilities consisted of data entry and maintenance of the operation software of CompuVend, Lightspeed, and Catapult. Through data entry, I assisted in inventory maintenance for the vending and micro market operations. I analyzed data to report sales, profits, and losses. Reports aided in strategic planning for inventory and marketing in vending and micro markets. In February 2016, Mastercraft Vending and Coffee sold to Canteen, an affiliate within the Compass Group organization.

positions.title: Designer - Special Events/Floral/Stage
positions.description: As a freelance designer, I worked with a small team to build and install floral and décor for weddings and special events. It is a fast-paced environment with tight schedules and deadlines. I acquired skills in organization, planning, and detail-oriented thinking to ensure successful deliveries and installations. I developed problem-solving skills in high-stress situations as problems occur on-site, but the clock is ticking, and a solution is needed.

positions.title: Floral Designer
positions.description: I had been brought on as a seasonal designer to assist in the high peak Valentine’s Day holiday rush. Afterward, Kinsch offered a full-time position as an in-house designer. I created over a hundred different floral designs for celebrations, funerals, and weddings. I have consulted clients in their needs and concerns as both a customer representative and as a designer.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Open Door Ministry at Vineyard Presbyterian Church
volunteerExperiences.description: This is a voluntary service. I design and oversee The Mustard Seeds, the toddler, pre-k, and kindergarten levels in VPC's Children's Ministry. I started as a volunteer, teaching a week’s lesion in scheduled rotation. In 2011, I took over leadership of the program. In 2010, the Mustard Seeds program started with eight children. By 2017, the number grew to 32 children in the Mustard Seeds program. Over twenty children have successfully graduated through the Mustard Seeds program into the elementary program, Joyland, and middle/high school youth program, Firm Foundations. I am responsible to develop curriculum and program suitable for children, ages 3-5. Utilize programs like Microsoft PowerPoint to create visual learning materials and videos, appropriate in age and content. Communicate with teachers and parents so curriculum correlate with the elementary school program and at home learning. Throughout the year, we run special events and an annual summer Vacation Bible School camp. With a small team, we brainstorm our own themes and build our own curriculum and brand. I delegate to the committees their responsibilities and goals so they can execute within the timeline.

volunteerExperience.companyName: Open Door Ministry at Vineyard Presbyterian Church
volunteerExperience.description: This is a voluntary service. I design and oversee The Mustard Seeds, the toddler, pre-k, and kindergarten levels in VPC's Children's Ministry. I started as a volunteer, teaching a week’s lesion in scheduled rotation. In 2011, I took over leadership of the program. In 2010, the Mustard Seeds program started with eight children. By 2017, the number grew to 32 children in the Mustard Seeds program. Over twenty children have successfully graduated through the Mustard Seeds program into the elementary program, Joyland, and middle/high school youth program, Firm Foundations. I am responsible to develop curriculum and program suitable for children, ages 3-5. Utilize programs like Microsoft PowerPoint to create visual learning materials and videos, appropriate in age and content. Communicate with teachers and parents so curriculum correlate with the elementary school program and at home learning. Throughout the year, we run special events and an annual summer Vacation Bible School camp. With a small team, we brainstorm our own themes and build our own curriculum and brand. I delegate to the committees their responsibilities and goals so they can execute within the timeline.
